notes.title: Update 0.1.1
notes.content:
Hi CRAFTers,

How are you guys doing? It’s been quite a while since our last “functional” update.

See what’s new here:

16 NEW MODELS added to the woodturning lathe, such as bowl, trees etc.. They can be used as a basis of your creation. More useful stuff can be created and shipped to you. Enjoy!
Announcing new CONNECTOR. You can use it to connect pieces together to build box, desk and something you like. Just let go your imagination and have fun
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27048922/0f9e5c5bcc011265cc301069c68fa57cd6dd1f12.png
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27048922/de6d4eb5ce89f55bfc332d320da6da81f50ce91b.png
Instruction Video. Yes, we added instruction video explaining all detailed steps & tips in CRAFT and you’ll never get lost again ;-)


Plans for next week:

New connectors will be added for you to explore more possibilities in CRAFT. Any ideas on new connector type? Contribute your thoughts, please
Spray painting still needs improvement. Some smooth doodling can be expected next week

Summer is coming, along with the good vibes. Have a nice weekend. Love your guys as always. ‘Till next time!

Best Regards
CRAFT Team

notes.title: Update 0.1.0
notes.content:
Woodturning Giveaway Campaign Ended!

Hi Guys

The physical woodturning giveaway campaign has ended today. Thanks for your participation and support. We’ve gathered much useful information for the function test. Most participants have had fun building in CRAFT. Their crafts are either under packaging or on the way : )

A full-price in-game purchase function test will begin this week. It will last for two weeks. Only $39 for getting the real object out of your VR making (shipping fee included, regardless of locations). CRAFTers can leave comments and feedbacks in the CRAFT discussion forum if there are any questions or problems during the purchase function test. 

Last but not least, there will a discount for physical fabrication of your workpiece when the function test is over. Follow our updates on Steam if you are interested. 

Till next time ~

Cheers, 
CRAFT Team

notes.title: Update 0.0.8 （Free Campaign For CRAFTers, Have Fun!）
notes.content:
Hi CRAFTers

We are back again. It’s been a while since our last update. Miss you guys so much. See what’s new here ; )

Yes, we said before about the new environment, and it’s finally here! Please check in and have a try. Let us know what you think about it. More assets will be added soon. Enjoy! P.S.: Any feedbacks will be greatly appreciated, any, I mean it

Small campaign here, totally free and we just hope you guys will have fun. The woodturning lathe is now open for test. If you make something via it, we are able to get your making file and produce the real object out. The function test will gradually get started from next week. CRAFTers who want to participate please leave a comment below. Once you get picked up, you’ll get the real object of your making at your home door because we’ll produce your VR making in the real digital fabrication factory. AND IT’S FREE!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27048922/20adb66ce9998e5cf1a1930ccc7cb4ea867b9895.jpg
Guys, have a try and get creative. We’ll be glad to see your feedbacks and comments. ‘Till next time!

Cheers,
CRAFT Team

notes.title: Update 0.0.7
notes.content:
Hi CRAFTers,

One week passed by and I hope you have enjoyed it. Nice to see you guys again

For the last week:

Video recorder is ready. Get creative and record some cool stuff. You can always find your videos and photos in your computer under the path C:\Users\Administrator\Documents\Work VR Shop
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27048922/a81a33e50d1e004d79f9b9b7cbf8e5321f50eb66.png
Some bugs of the camera have been fixed. Feel free to have a try
Announcing spray painting in CRAFT! Get some color for your making or simply try a bit doodling for fun : )
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27048922/ac52d1fcaaa54549a24bc2b2574148b3e4c5a498.png
The new environment is almost finished with more details being added. Check the pic below
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27048922/f815904b8dec49221dd1cf905e122e2f6cf450de.png
The “Demo” word in the game title really aroused some confusion. So we have removed it. This is a demo but people don’t have to buy it again later. This means, this is a lifetime game for people who buys it no matter it’s the early access version or the official version.

Plans for next week:

New environment will all be finished and we’ll test it first. Some performances surely need to be upgraded. We plan to update the new environment to CRAFT in February.

We’ll begin to prepare for the crowdfunding campaign next week. Certain features and functions will be under development. Although those features will not be released until the campaign ends, we’ll still update the relevant information here.

There might be some bugs with the video recorder. We'll work on it and any feedbacks will be greatly appreciated 


More to be expected. Have fun guys. ‘Till next time~

Best Regards
CRAFT Team

notes.title: Update 0.0.6
notes.content:
Hi CRAFTers,

How is your holiday? Happy to see you guys in 2017 : ) Here comes the update, as usual, enjoy!

For the last week:

We met some problems during the development of video recorder. The recorded videos can’t be saved under the specific path. We’ll keep working on it and hope to get it ready within next week

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27048922/041125ad6b00f83b9ab4a8bd6b13f38c6f44a2c2.png

Check what our desktop lathe can do now (see the .gif below). Make a bowl or cup for yourself and have fun in making ;)

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27048922/38d20354867fba941f2a4deb6b05929d818b1a55.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27048922/aa0f6272bad72110ba346b12342262c78ea172a9.png

Brand new benchsaw model for the new environment. This time we go the realistic style. Want to see how real it can be? Well, available soon in CRAFT

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27048922/dc71a97aa6de140826222bbf7254ad7897ddb02f.png

About the gameplay storyline, we tried hard, thinking over and over again about it, thinking and contemplating…….then, we fall asleep. Just kidding! Well, we hope to have a perfect storyline for CRAFT but we couldn’t think of a better idea after several discussion within the team. We don’t want to have a rough gameplay storyline in a hush neither. So we put of this part and decided to turn to the community first. Do you guys have any idea, suggestions or experience on CRAFT gameplay storyline? Or share some experience of your workshop/making experience with us? We started a community discussion here:http://steamcommunity.com/app/558740/discussions/0/142260895143766425/  We’d appreciate any thoughts from you guys

Plan for next week:

New environment models will all be finished by next week and will be upgraded to CRAFT game soon
Spray painting in CRAFT! Change the color of your making or do some doodling. More fun to be expected
We plan to launch CRAFT on Kickstarter in the next two or three months. More functions and gameplay features will be developed during this period. We may not update all of them on Steam until the campaign ends. Those features and development will be released after the Kickstarter campaign. No worries, we’ll still go on with our weekly updates here as usual :)

Happy 2017.  ‘Till Next Time

Best Regards
CRAFT Team

notes.content:
Hi CRAFTers,

Here we are again, enjoying our game development even more during the vacation season. A happy holiday and best wishes for a brand new year to you all   :3

For the last week:

Our model guy had a bad flu so there aren’t many details added for the environment. But we did change something, check the pictures below (the actual models will be added to CRAFT later)
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27048922/7b42cedaa695914433a34b9fabc86b6b521437ed.png
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27048922/1a1e2cc2042c034fbb11bd362d049d24f2ffd869.png
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27048922/1026cef6423cb1199ad72bfe2702edfc84567265.png
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27048922/2c5d12833cb1eae95670f703298823937c698c9d.png
Saving function finally added. Yes, now you can save your makings as you want and of course delete the ones that you don’t  need anymore. Have a try : )
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27048922/2e005d9557c3f8f5ece964b959405d800ad3f87e.png
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27048922/3eab08d4fc211e9b1071d1a17609272ae8c320d6.png

Sunrise and sunset, natural sunlight comes. Soon you’ll feel it while you are in CRAFT

Plan for next week:
Announcing video recorder! I know it’s a small device but think about it, you can get a video of your building process or yourself in CRAFT ; )

New cutter for lathe, which enables you to cut objects for a specific shape, like a bowl or similar stuff. Hope you’ll enjoy it

We’ll begin the gameplay storyline for CRAFT. Updates will be provided here regularly

Yes, my colleague, the model guy, will keep work on the details of the environment. A new benchsaw (different look from the existing one) can be expected to be added to the new environment.

Thanks for your continuous support and we really appreciate it. 2017 is meant to be a fantastic year with you guys. A happy new year, dear CRAFTers! Have a good time and all the best wishes for you

Best Regards
CRAFT Team

notes.title: Update 0.0.3
notes.content:
Hi All, here we are, again ; )

Thanks for your continuous support for CRAFT. We update our weekly tasks here every Friday. Hope you’ll enjoy them. For deeper discussions, please visit the CRAFT forum
http://steamcommunity.com/app/558740/discussions/

For the past week:

Some bugs about the connection parts are fixed, for example, the connection parts used to be sticky together. Now, not any more!
New Unlock Achievement! Man’s Work Beats The Work Of God. Curious or confused? Go into CRAFT and have a try
Camera function greatly improved. Yep, it’s time for a fancy photo
Some secret small gadgets added. Have fun
Desktop lathe added! More possibilities for what you can do in CRAFT. I played for a while, it’s actually good, I think ; )

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27048922/0595349b771cadea08bb47058e9658ba8d465e71.jpg

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27048922/cc0ed66090a729bbebaca4cc583c48318008870d.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27048922/746795fb1bc957d81eab9146eb1e0352b55ebff8.png


Plans for next week:

We want to add new theme / environment for the workshop. CRAFT will finally get a brand new look. Some rendering pictures will be finished by next week
About the wire-cut craft, we are working hard on it. Some progress can be expected next Friday
Announcing new feature: customizing your pieces. In simple words, you can change the models to many shapes you like (by using the desktop CNC !）
 Possible feature: saving your making!
AI upgrading for robot companion. Surprises coming~
New functions for lathe!

Still working hard. Any feedbacks or suggestions are warmly welcomed. Thanks everyone for being in CRAFT.
'Till next time!

Best Regards
CRAFT Team

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27048922/cc0ed66090a729bbebaca4cc583c48318008870d.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27048922/746795fb1bc957d81eab9146eb1e0352b55ebff8.png


Plans for next week:

We want to add new theme / environment for the workshop. CRAFT will finally get a brand new look. Some rendering pictures will be finished by next week
About the wire-cut craft, we are working hard on it. Some progress can be expected next Friday
Announcing new feature: customizing your pieces. In simple words, you can change the models to many shapes you like (by using the desktop CNC !）
 Possible feature: saving your making!
AI upgrading for robot companion. Surprises coming~
New functions for lathe!

Still working hard. Any feedbacks or suggestions are warmly welcomed. Thanks everyone for being in CRAFT.
'Till next time!

Best Regards
CRAFT Team

notes.title: Updates 0.0.2
notes.content:
Shortly after the release of CRAFT, we worked our efforts to update the game contents, and now you can assemble wood pieces together in CARFT! We’ll provide the development details here to keep you guys updated for the latest progress.

Changlist this time:

- Many specific bugs - yep, fixed!
- We made a survey and found it was easier to grab items by GRAB button. So, we've changed our previous way of grabbing things
- Connections parts - added! They can be used to assemble wood pieces. Now you can build the boards together freely. Enjoy it! In case you find it tricky with certain connection parts, just knock it with the hammer, yeah, as hard as you want ;)

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27048922/d3f68eb50e18f90f697e03bb3806f58bb508c947.jpg

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27048922/6edd68137530c19b4e82a705b4d36889e877eccb.jpg

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27048922/e6067d9a8a31edbde020e2c2ca99ecd55be846ab.jpg
- New Achievement Unlock added. Wanna have a try?

Updates and tasks for next week
Just in case we get lazy. Please be our witnesses ;)

- Improvements for the previous connection parts
- Announcing new equipment: Lathe !
- Begin the simulation of wire-cut craft
- New design models for the connection parts. More choices available :)

Thanks for your support and feedbacks, which are greatly appreciated. Yes, I mean it. Your helpful suggestions will speed up our improvements and updates for CRAFT. Again, thank you CARFTers.

Always strive to be better. Have a nice day. Love you guys ~
